name: AK23AH - Desktop Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity), NDIR Infrared & Electrochemical Sensors
highlights: The AK23A on Infrared and Electrochemical — Same buttonless twin-dial panel, same 32-per-carton spec. CO₂ moves to infrared NDIR and formaldehyde to an electrochemical cell — the pair that daily cleaning products otherwise disturb.

Built for Places That Are Cleaned Daily — Hotels, clinics and offices run disinfectant and polish through every room. Those products move a semiconductor reading and leave an infrared or electrochemical one alone — which is exactly why this tier exists.
Laser Particulates, Three Fractions — PM1.0, PM2.5 and PM10 reported independently.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four-hour charge, 256 g.
32 Per Carton — Same packing and freight profile as the standard version.
